feed_summary: After a three-month lull, Prince of Persia hid a Tornado C&C server on US shared hosting, its first US-based server since 2016. The post Iran’s Prince of Persia APT Hosts C&C in US for First Time Since 2016 appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Iran’s Prince of Persia APT Hosts C&C in US for First Time Since 2016
